title: SVAF Events Schema
description: Schema for the semantic event timeline (as built, format version 0.x)

t.description: Event time in seconds relative to the master audio

type.description: Flat event type, e.g. state_start, speaker_change, slide_start; unknown types MUST be ignored by readers

state.description: For state_* events: name of the state

speaker_track.description: For speaker_change events: track_id from tracks.json

identity_id.description: For speaker_change events: id from identities.json

asset.description: For slide_start events: relative path of the keyframe asset
